method: All displayed deck glosses and all generated present paradigms were read during this pass. The same-lemma source mapping gates generated inflections; handwritten exceptions resolve irregular patterns and lexical gender. This is a source-backed editorial audit, not independent certification or a corpus-token review.

functionWordReview.scope: All four demonstrative and four possessive cards in the current deck; existing grouped form rows audited for lookup omissions. This is not an exhaustive audit of pronouns, quantifiers or numeral paradigms.

sources.scope: Three demonstrative families including standalone neuters; short and long possessive forms and agreement.

functionWordReview.retained: Neuter forms do not replace agreeing forms in noun phrases. Existing contextual accepted answers remain unchanged. Other pronoun, quantifier and numeral cards are not asserted to have complete paradigms.
